mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settlement_monitoring WHERE alert_level IS NOT NULL AND alert_level != 'INFO' AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY monitor_time DESC
SELECT * FROM settlement_monitoring WHERE alert_level IN ('CRITICAL', 'HIGH') AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY monitor_time DESC

SELECT * FROM settlement_monitoring WHERE alert_level IS NOT NULL AND alert_level != 'INFO' AND (is_alert_sent = 0 OR is_alert_sent IS NULL) AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY CASE alert_level WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, monitor_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_monitoring SET is_alert_sent = 1, alert_sent_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE monitoring_id = #{monitoringId}

UPDATE settlement_monitoring SET is_alert_sent = 1, alert_sent_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE monitoring_id IN
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT AVG(health_score) as avgHealthScore, MIN(health_score) as minHealthScore, MAX(health_score) as maxHealthScore, AVG(success_rate) as avgSuccessRate, AVG(avg_processing_time) as avgProcessingTime, AVG(system_load) as avgSystemLoad, AVG(memory_usage) as avgMemoryUsage, AVG(cpu_usage) as avgCpuUsage, AVG(disk_usage) as avgDiskUsage, AVG(network_latency) as avgNetworkLatency, COUNT(CASE WHEN alert_level = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) as criticalAlertCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN alert_level = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highAlertCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN alert_level = 'MEDIUM' THEN 1 END) as mediumAlertCount FROM settlement_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND monitor_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)

SELECT monitor_type, COUNT(*) as recordCount, AVG(success_rate) as avgSuccessRate, AVG(avg_processing_time) as avgProcessingTime, SUM(transaction_count) as totalTransactionCount, SUM(success_count) as totalSuccessCount, SUM(failed_count) as totalFailedCount, AVG(health_score) as avgHealthScore, COUNT(CASE WHEN alert_level IN ('CRITICAL', 'HIGH') THEN 1 END) as alertCount FROM settlement_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND monitor_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY monitor_type ORDER BY monitor_type

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(monitor_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') as hour, AVG(success_rate) as avgSuccessRate, AVG(avg_processing_time) as avgProcessingTime, AVG(system_load) as avgSystemLoad, AVG(memory_usage) as avgMemoryUsage, AVG(cpu_usage) as avgCpuUsage, AVG(network_latency) as avgNetworkLatency, SUM(transaction_count) as totalTransactionCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN alert_level IN ('CRITICAL', 'HIGH') THEN 1 END) as alertCount FROM settlement_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND monitor_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(monitor_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') ORDER BY hour
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settlement_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND monitor_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(monitor_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') as hour, AVG(health_score) as avgHealthScore, MIN(health_score) as minHealthScore, MAX(health_score) as maxHealthScore, COUNT(CASE WHEN health_score < 60 THEN 1 END) as unhealthyCount FROM settlement_monitoring WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND monitor_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(monitor_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') ORDER BY hour
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_monitoring SET health_score = #{healthScore}, update_time = NOW() WHERE monitoring_id = #{monitoringId}
